prompt:
Draw ONE complete full-colour manga PAGE, portrait, read left to right, with exactly FOUR panels, black panel borders, thin white gutters and a small white page margin. Style: approachable Indian slice-of-life manga, clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural light, simple readable backgrounds, expressive natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. BALLOON SPACE: in EVERY panel keep the upper quarter as plain empty background (plain wall, ceiling or sky) with no faces, hands, screens or important objects in it; speech balloons and captions are added there later. Keep heads below that band. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, words, numbers, speech balloons, captions, sound effects, signage text, logos, brand marks or watermarks. Do not draw any Welbuk logo, and no heart, cross or medical-cross symbols. Screens show only simple abstract interface shapes: a hot-pink (#FD006A) header bar, white cards, grey lines, simple icons and charts; never readable text or numbers. All data is fictional.

REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 = main-cast.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels); Image 2 = vision-cast.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels).

CAST ON THIS PAGE:
RAVI: Ravi, Indian man, mid 30s, patient; short neat black hair with side part, short trimmed beard, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, wristwatch on his LEFT wrist; thick straight brows, square jaw.
SPECIALIST: the Specialist, Indian man, 50s; greying temples, rimless glasses, grey moustache, light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, stethoscope.

PAGE LAYOUT: Panel 1 tall on the left half spanning the top 62% of the page; panels 2 and 3 stacked on the right half beside it; panel 4 full-width at the bottom (about 38%).

PANELS (left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading order):
Panel 1: Tall panel: Ravi on a train by the window, a different Indian city skyline outside (no signs or text), phone in hand.
Panel 2: Ravi standing outside a modern clinic in the new city, looking at his phone, hopeful.
Panel 3: Close-up of his phone: an abstract consent screen with a toggle switched on and a doctor icon linked by a dotted line.
Panel 4: Inside the clinic: the Specialist with a tablet warmly welcoming Ravi, open hand.

PAGE NOTES: All four panels are a future vision: soft pale-pink vignette border and a lighter, airy palette.
